per_case_results.question: How many comments were added to the post with the highest score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId GROUP BY T1.Id ORDER BY T1.Score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM "comments" "c"
JOIN "posts" "p" ON "c"."postid" = "p"."id"
WHERE "p"."score" = (SELECT MAX("score") FROM "posts")
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T1.CreationDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "c"."text", "u"."displayname"
FROM "comments" "c"
JOIN "users" "u" ON "c"."userid" = "u"."id"
WHERE "c"."postid" = (
    SELECT "id" FROM "posts" WHERE "title" = 'Analysing wind data with R' LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY "c"."creationdate" DESC
LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "score" > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage"
FROM "posts"
WHERE "owneruserid" = (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "users"
    ORDER BY "reputation" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
